claim_zh: 人格类型不能作为本项目的能力选拔依据
claim_en: Personality labels are not ability-selection criteria in this project
location: Ethical principles: type-based selection/restriction and stereotypes
limits: Provider guidance; not validation of this study

claim_en: 16Personalities is not automatically pooled with formal MBTI measurements
limits: Supports source distinction; not a comparative psychometric study

claim_zh: 题型与顺序可能影响回答，应先试填
claim_en: Question format and order can affect responses; pilot first
location: Open- and closed-ended questions; Question order
limits: Does not establish validity of this questionnaire

claim_zh: Pages提供静态托管，不自动接收本问卷答案
claim_en: Pages supplies static hosting; the form does not automatically upload answers
verification: Opened official documentation and inspected local no-network form
limits: Hosting service may log visits; no claim of anonymous hosting

claim_zh: 附件上传即时发生且公开附件可公开访问
claim_en: Attachments upload immediately and public attachments are publicly accessible
location: Who can use this feature; supported file types
verification: Opened official documentation in this task
limits: No promise that public copies can be recalled

claim_en: 49 and 34 total items; 28 and 13 core process items
verification: Counted generator data and matched generated files
limits: Counts include optional/conditional items; completion time unmeasured

claim_zh: 当前问卷仅支持关联与自报体验，客观增益需另一设计
claim_en: Current reports support associations and self-report; objective gains need another design
verification: Checked item-to-question mapping and absence of objective control conditions
limits: Design judgment, not an empirical finding

claim_zh: 没有真人样本、实验或功效结果被作为本项目发现报告
claim_en: No human findings, experiment results or completed power analysis are reported
verification: Inspected public package; excluded output and local archives
limits: Future participation and analyses require separate records
